Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

manimR 0.1.0

  • First release: a native R port of Manim Community 0.22 (the Cairo style renderer), covering every public name and class method of from manim import * (checked by tests/testthat/test-api-coverage.R). Every upstream class has an R6 generator FooClass, including the ones upstream defines only to preset arguments.
  • Output follows Manim 0.22’s render sessions: format is "auto", "mp4", "mov", "webm", "gif", "png" (last frame), "png-sequence" or "none", with dry_run, directory templates (get_dir()), manim.cfg files (digest_config_file()), encoder settings and per scene log files. Partial movie files are cached by a hash of each play, and sections, sound and subtitles are written as upstream.
  • Tex() and MathTex() through LaTeX and dvisvgm, Typst() and MathTypst() through the typst compiler, Text() and MarkupText() through system fonts, and Code() highlighted with Pygments when Python has it.
  • The command line (manim_cli()) takes manim render’s options and the checkhealth, cfg, init, plugins and cache clear subcommands.
  • RStudio addins (including rendering as a background job), a manim knitr engine for R Markdown and Quarto, printing of render() results in documents, Shiny output functions (manimOutput(), renderManim()) and an interactive Shiny window for scenes.
  • as_mobject() turns ggplot2, grid and base graphics into mobjects, scene_frame() renders one frame of a scene, expect_snapshot_frame() tests frames with testthat, and GraphClass$from_igraph() imports igraph graphs.
  • The mobject classes of upstream’s OpenGL renderer (OpenGLCircle(), OpenGLVGroup(), OpenGLSurface() and the rest) are subclasses of their Cairo counterparts, so code written for that renderer runs unchanged; OpenGLSurfaceMesh() and OpenGLTexturedSurface() are ported to grid.
  • Images are drawn through the homography of their corners with Pillow’s nearest, bilinear and bicubic filters, and an image seen edge on is skipped as upstream.

Developed by Adam R Sophie.
